meta.title: Where a Query Actually Filters
meta.subtitle: Five rejections at five granularities — and only the last one costs anything per entity

views.label: Most of it happens once
views.note: Archetype matching runs when the query is made, and again when a new archetype is born. Never inside your update.

views.label: A bloom filter guards the gate
views.note: Five bits per component type, or-ed into one word. A single AND rejects most archetypes before any type index is read.

views.label: The chunk list is a flat array
views.note: Every matching chunk from every matching archetype, flattened into one array, rebuilt only after something drops it.

views.label: The only per-entity cost
views.note: A version compare can skip a whole chunk. Inside a chunk that survives, a 128-bit mask picks entities with count-trailing-zeros.

cards.title: What runs when
items: Matching runs at query creation and when a new archetype is born · EntityQueryManager.cs:945
A match adds a record to the query and a back pointer to the archetype · lines 967, 970
The chunk list is rebuilt only after an invalidation, not every update · EntityQueryManager.cs:1593
Archetypes holding zero entities are skipped during that rebuild · EntityQueryManager.cs:1604

cards.title: The bloom filter nobody mentions
items: Each component type hashes to five bits of a 64-bit word · TypeManager.cs:3492
An archetype's mask is the OR of all its types' masks · EntityComponentStore.cs:2421
A query whose required bits are missing is rejected in one AND · EntityQueryManager.cs:1077
The source explains the choice of five: fewer collides, more hides misses · TypeManager.cs:3494

cards.title: The filter has a hard ceiling
items: Shared component filtering holds at most two values · EntityQueryFilter.cs:12
Change filtering holds at most two component types · EntityQueryFilter.cs:22
Both compare a stored version, so the unit of skipping is a whole chunk
Filtering is skipped entirely unless one of those counts is non-zero · EntityQueryFilter.cs:35

cards.title: Inside a surviving chunk
items: The enableable state is two 64-bit words, one bit per slot · ChunkEntityEnumerator.cs:17
The next entity is count-trailing-zeros of the low word · ChunkEntityEnumerator.cs:62
Then the lowest set bit is cleared with a single AND · ChunkEntityEnumerator.cs:63
With nothing enableable the mask is all ones and the loop is a plain range
